      "options": [

      "evidence": "\"there are capacity limits on how much can be transported between any two cities\" and \"The transportation must respect the capacity limits on each route\"",
      "options": [
        "Variable bounds only (0 <= x[i,j] <= capacity[i,j])",
        "Explicit constraint x[i,j] <= capacity[i,j] in addition to variable bounds",
        "Both variable bounds and explicit constraints (redundant but harmless)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.5,

        0.25
      ],
      "majority_option": "Both variable bounds and explicit constraints (redundant but harmless)"
    },

      "evidence": "\"the amount of resources transported cannot be negative\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "flow_balance_orientation",
      "evidence": "\"the total amount of resources sent out plus its supply must equal the total amount received plus its demand\"",
      "options": [
        "supply + outflow = demand + inflow (outflow - inflow = demand - supply)",

        "outflow - inflow = supply - demand"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.2,
        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "supply + outflow = demand + inflow (outflow - inflow = demand - supply)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_units_and_scale",
      "evidence": "\"minimize the total transportation cost\" and \"The cost of transporting resources from City 0 to City 1 is 6\"",
      "options": [
        "Sum of cost[i,j] * x[i,j] in raw cost units",

      "evidence": "\"The cost of transporting resources from City 0 to City 1 is 6 ... From City 8 to City 7, the cost is 10\"",

      ],

    }
